review.evidence: Fresh five-chain EVM reads on 15 October bind exact CHF token authority/mint/upgrade masks and chain-local ADMIN Safe owners, thresholds, modules, guard slots and fallback addresses; executable fallback reach, module-guard state and complete group membership remain open. Finalized Solana slot 457209716 binds the exact CHF mint to its MinterConfig, one-member admin Squads and the same member's direct program-upgrade authority; current minter executable bytes match immutable verified source. The AMF certificate of 23 February 2026 names issuing SPIKO SICAV SCV20240012 and its SAFO sub-fund SCV20260075 as French UCITS, and identifies Twenty First Capital GP-11000029 as manager. This establishes prudential supervision of the exact issuing fund, not merely custodian regulation. Reconciliation is corrected from periodic to unknown: daily NAV and share-class arithmetic, recurring fund reporting and a named statutory auditor do not establish a recurring match of all CHF native liabilities and circulation exclusions to backing. The June 30 report contains no CHF share row or financial audit opinion, and no current independent all-register CHF or all-class reconciliation was retrieved. The unbounded-reconciled annotation is retained for independently established prudential supervision alone, not for a claimed reconciliation cadence. Complete Starknet/Stellar controllers, alternative execution paths and independent beneficial key custody remain unestablished.
